script.description: Path to the .josh simulation script file whose grid definition will be used to align the data.

simulation.description: Name of the simulation block inside the script that defines the target grid (e.g. 'Main').

dataFile.description: Path to the input data file. Supported formats: NetCDF (.nc), GeoTIFF (.tiff/.tif), or existing Josh binary (.jshd).

variable.description: Variable name to extract from the data file, or a band number for GeoTIFF files.

unitsStr.description: Physical units for the extracted data, as understood by Josh (e.g. 'count', 'meters', 'kg/m^2'). These units will be attached to the values in the output .jshd file and must match what the simulation expects.

outputFile.description: Path where the preprocessed .jshd file should be written. Use .jshdz extension for compressed output.

crs.description: Coordinate reference system code used to read the source file. Defaults to 'EPSG:4326'.

xCoord.description: Name of the horizontal coordinate dimension in the source file. Defaults to 'lon'.

yCoord.description: Name of the vertical coordinate dimension in the source file. Defaults to 'lat'.

timeDim.description: Name of the time dimension in the source file. Defaults to 'calendar_year'. Set this whenever the source uses a different name (commonly 'time'); ignored when noTimeDim is true.

noTimeDim.description: Set true for a source with no time dimension, such as a flat raster. Defaults to false.

timestep.description: Process only this single timestep instead of the simulation's whole step range. Used to split a large source into per-timestep jobs that are later combined with amend.

defaultValue.description: Numeric value used to fill grid cells before copying data from the source, for cells the source does not cover. Ignored when amend is true.

parallel.description: Process patches within each timestep in parallel. Defaults to false.

amend.description: Add timestep slices to an existing output file instead of overwriting it. Amended slices must be contiguous with, and later than, those already in the file.

timeType.description: Type of temporal metadata to record in the output .jshd: 'count' for numeric coordinates such as calendar years, 'ISO' for calendar dates. Defaults to 'count'. On its own this writes nothing; at least one of timeStart, timeUnit, timeCount, timeInterval, or timeInstant must also be given.

timeStart.description: First temporal coordinate of a range: a number when timeType is 'count' (e.g. '2015'), or an ISO date when timeType is 'ISO' (e.g. '2024-01-01'). Requires timeCount.

timeUnit.description: Unit of a count axis, e.g. 'year'. Required when timeType is 'count'; must be omitted when timeType is 'ISO'.

timeCount.description: Number of temporal coordinates in the axis. Must equal the number of timestep slices being written, which is the simulation's step range, or 1 when timestep is set.

timeIncrement.description: Spacing between count-axis coordinates. Defaults to 1. Only valid when timeType is 'count'.

timeInterval.description: ISO-8601 period between coordinates, e.g. 'P1D', 'P1M', 'P1Y'. Required when timeType is 'ISO' and a range is declared; must be omitted when timeType is 'count'.

timeInstant.description: Single temporal coordinate for a one-slice output, in place of timeStart/timeCount. Use this instead of a range when timestep is set. A count instant also requires timeUnit.
